items.title: Realty Income (O) Stock Sees Modest Fair Value Cut As Analysts Trim Growth Views
items.summary: The latest update on Realty Income includes a modest trim to fair value, with the modeled estimate moving from US$64.87 to US$63.25. This shift aligns with analyst commentary that balances confidence in Realty Income as a core net lease holding with caution around higher rates, funding costs, and sector multiples. items.title: Realty Income Just Raised Its Dividend Hours After the 10-Year Treasury Hit 5%. A Widow With $300,000 in the Stock Now Gets $1,370 a Month. Here’s How Safe the Check Is
items.summary: Realty Income raised its monthly dividend to $0.274 a share on Tuesday, hours after the 10-year Treasury touched 5%. For a 72-year-old widow with 5,000 shares, that is $1,370 a month. Here is how well the cash covers it, what a 5% Treasury does to the share price, and why the check costs her half as much tax in a brokerage account as it would from her IRA.
